about: Classic Klondike solitaire. Move cards between the seven piles in alternating colours, counting down, and build each suit from Ace to King on the foundations. Easy deals one card at a time with unlimited undo, Normal one card, Hard three cards at a time.
controls: Drag cards, or tap a card to send it where it fits best. Tap the deck to draw. Undo and Auto finish buttons on the right.
name: Solitaire
tagline: Klondike patience: build the four suits up from Ace to King.
